# Shared pricing calculations

[Module map](../README.md) · [Source directory](../../../packages/pricing)

Compute channel-aware pricing breakdowns from explicit inputs and shared constants.

**Scope:** Pure calculation code; does not fetch prices, establish source rights or enable new paid commerce.

**Placement:** pnpm workspace member; package `@cambridge-tcg/pricing`.

## Progress

Source review recorded **2026-09-28**. Pricing functions, channel defaults and unit tests are present. The older pricing-current-state document is a historical consolidation plan. 2026-09-29: decimal major-unit money, finite input/config validation and stable GBP rounding added. Direct channel writers and previews validate compatible configuration.

This records source and documentation evidence. It does not establish deployment, external access, service health, or passing tests.

**Next review:** Reuse these functions instead of copying formulas; verify host-side database overrides and preserve the commercial boundary.
